name: E-Commerce: Mobile App Conversion & Engagement core scenarios
description: Evaluation scenarios for E-Commerce: Mobile App Conversion & Engagement.

parts.text: What is our mobile app crash-free session rate and how does it differ between iOS and Android?
iOS maintains a 99.94% crash-free session rate meeting our 99.9% target SLA, while Android averages 99.88% primarily impacted by NullPointerException occurrences.
What was the conversion rate and attributed revenue for push notification campaign PUSH-701?
Push campaign PUSH-701 generated $146,600.00 total revenue across platforms, with an iOS open-to-purchase conversion rate of 14.1% and Android conversion rate of 14.1%.
What is the full-funnel conversion rate from app opens to purchases for iOS and Android?
The end-to-end app conversion rate is 5.97% on iOS (8,650 purchases from 145k opens) and 5.15% on Android (6,700 purchases from 130k opens).
What are industry standard benchmarks for retail mobile app conversion rates and push open rates?
Retail mobile apps average between 4.5% and 6.0% overall session conversion rates, with rich personalized push notifications averaging 8% to 12% open rates.
